subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `canYield` plus `yieldToolResult(...)` as the permanent public Plugin SDK contract, including direct model visibility for yield-capable tools?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish that the implementation works, but code review cannot decide whether this public SDK and catalog behavior is the long-term product contract maintainers want external plugins to depend on.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in public API and direct-surface scheduling rule, then land the exact head after required checks finish.

options.title: Request a different SDK shape
options.body: Keep the capability but require the contributor to revise naming, ownership, or catalog semantics before the public surface ships.

options.title: Defer plugin-controlled yield
options.body: Pause or close the PR and retain only the model-facing `sessions_yield` primitive until a maintained consumer establishes the desired API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in public API and direct-surface scheduling rule, then land the exact head after required checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the foundational `sessions_yield` lifecycle that this public SDK extension reuses.
